units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:1">Shebu. VI, 1</cite> <he>הט׳ … וההודאה וכ׳</he> if the claim is for two M’ah silver, and the defendant admits the value of a P’rutah.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אם אין ההודאה ממין הט׳</he> if the defendant’s admission is not homogeneous with the claim (e.g. one sues for wheat and the defendant alleges to owe barley). Ib. 39ᵇ <he>כפירת ט׳ שתי וכ׳</he> the claim of two M’ah in the Mishnah means that amount of the claim which is disputed; <he>ט׳ עצמה וכ׳</he> it means that the original claim was for two &c.
